"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Checkbox as CheckboxPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/checkbox" import { Icon } from "@iconify/react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" /* * Atelier Checkbox: unchecked it is a quiet near-white well; checked it * becomes the primary button's material scaled down: the same deep green * fill, top-light rim and soft green drop (--shadow-primary). * * Base UI splits Radix's checked="indeterminate" into a separate boolean * `indeterminate` prop; the Root renders a , so disabled styling * hangs off data-disabled instead of the :disabled pseudo-class. */ // Base UI className can be a state function; the wrapper feeds it to cn(), so // narrow it to a plain string (same treatment as the other ported files). type WithClassName

= Omit & { className?: string } const Checkbox = React.forwardRef< HTMLSpanElement, WithClassName >(({ className, indeterminate, ...props }, ref) => ( {indeterminate ? ( ) : ( )} )) Checkbox.displayName = "Checkbox" export { Checkbox }
